description: This file defines an abstract base class for a list of entity conditions in the OFBiz framework. It handles combining multiple condition expressions with a specified operator, providing methods to retrieve conditions, generate SQL snippets, check conditions, and manage object equality.

classes.name: EntityConditionListBase
classes.description: An abstract class representing a list of entity condition expressions combined with a specific join operator.

methods.name: getConditions
methods.description: Returns the list of condition expressions that are being combined.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the operator used to combine the conditions (e.g., AND, OR).

methods.name: getCondition
methods.description: Retrieves a specific condition by index from the list.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the combined condition list is empty according to the operator's criteria.

methods.name: makeWhereString
methods.description: Generates the SQL WHERE clause string based on the conditions and operator.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Validates the condition against the model entity, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Checks if the condition matches a given map of values.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Returns an immutable version of the condition.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on conditions and operator.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code based on conditions and operator.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the condition.
